headline: Warehouse-robot start-up Ultra has raised $62 million to roll out its OP1 packing robot to more customers.
score_reason: Funding for robots already in real warehouses, but the figures come from the company and its investor.
importance_line: Warehouse workers and online retailers are affected as packing robots spread, but the 500,000-order figure comes from investor Y Combinator and the pace of rollout is unproven.
summary: AI Insider reports that Ultra, a start-up making the OP1 warehouse packing robot, has raised $62 million, including a $50 million Series A led by Framework with Y Combinator taking part, to expand its deployments. Y Combinator says Ultra's robots already work in US warehouses and have packed more than 500,000 orders, and customers pay an installation fee plus a subscription.
notes: Funding round; the robots operate but the story is the funding.
